name: The Sky Residences at W Aspen
insider_take: Where Aspen's legendary mountain culture meets razor-sharp W Hotels attitude — The Sky Residences redefine what it means to live at altitude.
whats_special: Perched in the heart of Aspen, The Sky Residences at W Aspen offer a rare blend of residential-style luxury and full W Hotels service. As part of Marriott's prestigious Luminous Program , guests enjoy elevated Bonvoy benefits alongside sweeping Elk Mountain views. The property sits steps from the base of Aspen Mountain (Ajax), putting world-class skiing and the celebrated après-ski scene of Aspen's historic core literally at your doorstep. Designed with a bold, contemporary aesthetic, these spacious residences feature full kitchens, private terraces, and curated mountain-modern interiors that feel more like a chic alpine home than a hotel room.
pro_tip: Book a Sky Residence with a mountain-facing terrace during ski season and wake up watching first tracks cut into the fresh powder on Ajax — then walk directly to the Silver Queen Gondola in under five minutes. Marriott Bonvoy Luminous members should always check for exclusive rate benefits before booking direct.
pros: Prime ski-in/ski-out access to Aspen Mountain slopes
Spacious, residence-style suites with full kitchens and mountain views
W Hotels signature amenities including rooftop pool, AWAY Spa, and vibrant dining
Eligible for Marriott Luminous exclusive benefits including upgrades and resort credits
Bold, designer interiors blending modern luxury with Rocky Mountain character
cons: Ultra-premium pricing reflective of Aspen's exclusive luxury market
Lively W Hotels atmosphere may not suit guests seeking a quiet, traditional alpine retreat
Peak season availability is extremely limited — early booking strongly recommended
